summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Grupo Aval Acciones y Valores S.A., a Colombian financial institution, solely to report that the May 2026 dividend payment was made as approved by shareholders on March 27, 2026. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring—is involved. The filing contains no terms, board recommendations, or structural mechanics beyond confirming a standard dividend distribution. There is no risk-arb angle or actionable corporate action to monitor.
